statement: The record ties BK-2021 to ST-77 but incorrectly marks its legal retention as expired; because it must be kept until 31 December 2028, I will place it on hold rather than purge it.
judge_text:
WRONG

"incorrectly marks its legal retention as expired" — asserts the record's value contradicts the stated 2028 retention.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
